# Creator Kit Hub

> Creator Kit Hub offers a comprehensive, completely free, and 100% offline suite of client-side web tools.

Because the application runs entirely in the browser using client-side JavaScript and WebAssembly, no files or data are ever uploaded to a remote server. This setup guarantees 100% data privacy, fast processing, and zero bandwidth limits.

## Available Tools

### PDF Toolkit
- [PDF Merger](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/merger/): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file quickly and securely.
- [PDF Splitter](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/splitter/): Extract PDF pages into individual files.
- [PDF Page Remover](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/remover/): Select and delete unwanted pages from PDF files.
- [PDF Watermark](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/watermark/): Apply text or image stamps to protect documents.
- [PDF Rotator](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/rotate/): Rotate PDF pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- [PDF to JPG](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert robust PDF pages into high-quality JPGs.
- [PDF Metadata Sanitizer](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/sanitizer/): Scrub hidden EXIF and authorship data from PDFs.
- [PDF Stamper](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/stamper/): Add custom pagination or sequential page numbers.
- [Image to PDF](https://creatorkithub.org/pdf-toolkit/image-to-pdf/): Merge and sequence JPG, PNG and WebP into one PDF document.

### Creator Utilities
- [Universal Image Converter](https://creatorkithub.org/universal-image-converter/): Convert images between HEIC, JPG, PNG, WEBP and more locally.
- [A11y Scorecard](https://creatorkithub.org/a11y-scorecard/): Check color contrast ratios for Web Accessibility (WCAG).
- [PrivaShield EXIF Stripper](https://creatorkithub.org/privashield/): Protect privacy by stripping GPS and EXIF data from photos.
- [CryptoAudit Password Analyzer](https://creatorkithub.org/crypto-audit/): Local password security checking.
- [Text Encryption](https://creatorkithub.org/text-encryption/): Client-side message AES encrypter/decrypter.
- [Color Palette Extractor](https://creatorkithub.org/palette-extractor/): Identify color schemes from images entirely via browser.
- [Pomodoro Tracker](https://creatorkithub.org/pomodoro-tracker/): Offline productivity timer.
- [Tone Analyzer](https://creatorkithub.org/tone-analyzer/): Analyze text for word count and underlying sentiment tone.
- [Lorem Ipsum Builder](https://creatorkithub.org/lorem-builder/): Client-side customized text generation.
- [SVG Tracer](https://creatorkithub.org/svg-tracer/): Offline raster to SVG vector conversion.
- [Social Media Safe Zone Overlay](https://creatorkithub.org/social-media-safe-zone-overlay/): Preview video dimensions and UI boundaries for TikTok/Reels/Shorts.

## Full Context
A more comprehensive context regarding architecture and individual tool features is available at [/llms-full.txt](https://creatorkithub.org/llms-full.txt).
